info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce Analytics REST Change Events Composite API
Salesforce Sales Cloud Execute a composite request

items.docs: Executes a series of REST API requests in a single call. Each request can reference the results of previous requests via referenceId, enabling dependent operations. Supports up to 25 subrequests per composite call. If allOrNone is true, all subrequests are rolled back on any failure.
